basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: Degree or equivalent in Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics & Communication Engineering from a recognised University / Institution (4 year Degree course); for absorption, officers of Major Ports holding analogous posts or posts in the scale of Rs.24900-50500/- with the regular service prescribed in the Recruitment Rules
qualification.details: Qualification: Degree or equivalent in Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics & Communication Engineering from a recognised University / Institution (4 year Degree course); officers of Major Ports eligible for absorption as per Annexure-I Experience: For absorption: officers holding analogous posts or holding posts in the scale of pay of Rs.24900-50500/- with 3 years regular service in the grade, or officers holding posts in the scale of pay of Rs.24900-50500/- with 2 years regular service in the grade and a combined regular service of 7 years in the scales of pay of Rs.24900-50500/- and Rs.20600-46500/- in the Mechanical & Electrical Engineering Department in a Major Port Trust Age limit: Maximum 50 years (as on 1 December 2026) | Other conditions: | Only officers of Major Ports fulfilling the Recruitment Rules at Annexure-I may apply Crucial date for determining eligibility is 01.12.2026 Vigilance and administrative clearance of the concerned Port is required

how_to_apply: Apply only on the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways at https://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in from 06.11.2026 to 05.12.2026.
Submit the printout of the application as uploaded in the OAP, with all enclosures, to your administrative Port.
The administrative Port forwards the application with the listed documents in an envelope superscribed 'Application for the post of Sr. Dy. Manager, Plant & Equipment Division, HDC, SMPA'.
The forwarded application must reach the office of the undersigned at HDC on or before 21.12.2026.
important_instructions: An advance copy is not considered unless the application through proper channel reaches HDC by 21.12.2026 An official who withdraws after selection by the Service Selection Committee is liable for debarment from Dy. HoD level selection in all Major Ports for two years Details of any major or minor penalty in the last 10 years may be sent by the forwarding authority with the application

content_sections.heading: SMPA Senior Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.syama_prasad_mookerjee_port_kolkata_smpa: Degree or equivalent in Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics & Communication Engineering from a recognised University / Institution (4 year Degree course); for absorption, officers of Major Ports holding analogous posts or posts in the scale of Rs.24900-50500/- with the regular service prescribed in the Recruitment Rules

content_sections.heading: SMPA Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. P&IR/13/2/2026/4396 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download SMPA notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Degree or equivalent in Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics & Communication Engineering from a recognised University / Institution (4 year Degree course); officers of Major Ports eligible for absorption as per Annexure-I Experience: For absorption: officers holding analogous posts or holding posts in the scale of pay of Rs.24900-50500/- with 3 years regular service in the grade, or officers holding posts in the scale of pay of Rs.24900-50500/- with 2 years regular service in the grade and a combined regular service of 7 years in the scales of pay of Rs.24900-50500/- and Rs.20600-46500/- in the Mechanical & Electrical Engineering Department in a Major Port Trust Age limit: Maximum 50 years (as on 1 December 2026) Other conditions: Only officers of Major Ports fulfilling the Recruitment Rules at Annexure-I may apply Crucial date for determining eligibility is 01.12.2026 Vigilance and administrative clearance of the concerned Port is required

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for SMPA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications not submitted through the OAP are not accepted

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Post filled by absorption through Composite method Actual filling up of the vacancy is subject to concurrence / approval of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways

rows.event: Application through proper channel to reach HDC

content_sections.heading: How Will SMPA Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Selection by merit with benchmark in overall grading in ACRs / APARs not below Very Good Selection by the Service Selection Committee Selection is by merit Benchmark in overall grading in ACRs / APARs will not be below Very Good

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Copies of APARs for the last 5 years (2021-22 to 2025-26), each page attested by an Officer not below Dy. HoD rank Self-certified photocopies of certificates, proof of educational qualification and present and past work experience No objection certificate from the respective Port to relieve the applicant if selected Undertaking that candidature will not be withdrawn if selected by the Service Selection Committee Vigilance and administrative clearance as per Annexure-II and vigilance report in Annexure-III format Two recent passport size colour photographs and complete service details with posts held

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SMPA Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply only on the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways at https://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in from 06.11.2026 to 05.12.2026. Submit the printout of the application as uploaded in the OAP, with all enclosures, to your administrative Port. The administrative Port forwards the application with the listed documents in an envelope superscribed 'Application for the post of Sr. Dy. Manager, Plant & Equipment Division, HDC, SMPA'. The forwarded application must reach the office of the undersigned at HDC on or before 21.12.2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: An advance copy is not considered unless the application through proper channel reaches HDC by 21.12.2026 An official who withdraws after selection by the Service Selection Committee is liable for debarment from Dy. HoD level selection in all Major Ports for two years Details of any major or minor penalty in the last 10 years may be sent by the forwarding authority with the application

content_sections.heading: SMPA Senior Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SMPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 5 December 2026. Applications opened on 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SMPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Senior Deputy Manager.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for SMPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 50 years (as on 1 December 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 80,000 - 2,20,000 (pre-revised Rs. 32,900 - 58,000), Dy. HoD level.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Degree or equivalent in Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics & Communication Engineering from a recognised University / Institution (4 year Degree course); for absorption, officers of Major Ports holding analogous posts or posts in the scale of Rs.24900-50500/- with the regular service prescribed in the Recruitment Rules.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only officers of Major Ports fulfilling the Recruitment Rules at Annexure-I may apply. Crucial date for determining eligibility is 01.12.2026. Vigilance and administrative clearance of the concerned Port is required.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications not submitted through the OAP are not accepted.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection by merit with benchmark in overall grading in ACRs / APARs not below Very Good. Selection by the Service Selection Committee. Selection is by merit. Benchmark in overall grading in ACRs / APARs will not be below Very Good.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post filled by absorption through Composite method. Actual filling up of the vacancy is subject to concurrence / approval of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways.
